bullets.text: Ukraine is facing a critical shortage of Patriot interceptors, leaving its cities vulnerable to Russian missile attacks, according to Ukrainian officials after a deadly strike in Kyiv.
The US State Department plans to close five consulates in various countries, including Canada, Japan, and Cameroon, raising concerns that China might expand its diplomatic presence in these regions.
UN forecasters warn that the El Niño weather phenomenon could drive an additional 50 million people into acute hunger across 45 countries by the end of next year.
New South Wales is experiencing its 30th consecutive warmer than average winter, leading to the rapid disappearance of snowy winters in regional areas.
Australian MPs will assess the country's preparedness for war, proposing a formal plan for the first time since World War II amidst growing regional conflict concerns.
Nearly 1,500 properties bought using Australia’s first home buyer's 5% deposit scheme have been converted into investments, with some high-income earners utilizing the program.
The US has suspended government activities in Michoacán, Mexico, jeopardizing avocado imports from the region, the largest producer for the US market.
Gold prices surged, marking their biggest jump since February, due to reduced expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes following prospects of a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
Two private credit funds managed by Blue Owl Capital Inc. bought back a combined $90 million of shares for the second consecutive quarter, aiming to stabilize the vehicles' value.
